## Objective

Exercise actual category/context/ownership flows and issue a source-bound release assessment.

## Scope

- Exercise native generic memory use
- Exercise native complex frozen context
- Exercise native extra-complex review gates
- Exercise native material-change and recovery gates
- Validate fresh-context root capture and recall
- Verify the integrated change and preservation

## Entry conditions

- Deterministic integration passed; backend decision recorded; actual native tools and scope available.

## Exit criteria

- Generic, complex, extra-complex, material-change and fresh-context evidence is current or explicitly unmet.
- Bidirectional coverage, preservation and release status reflect the actual highest verification level.

## Risks

- Serialize shared-file edits and honor every task-specific authority, preservation and evidence gate.

## TASK-045 - Exercise native complex frozen context

Run a complex scenario with at least two independent full-problem solvers, including queued dispatch, a distinct senior and the dedicated implementer when implementation is requested. Bind the identical frozen packet before the first solver and defer sibling draft reads until all initial solvers launch.

| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |

| Target artifacts | Verification/project-memory/native-complex-results.json |
| Dependencies | TASK-044 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Queue within observed capacity without reducing the team; reject unsupported context inheritance rather than asking contaminated solvers to ignore it.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every solver receives the same exact packet/baseline and confirmed model/effort; native inherited context excludes sibling content.
- Complex work retains its full solver/senior topology without a mandatory per-candidate reviewer; accepted implementation uses a distinct authorized implementer when applicable.

### Planned verification

- Inspect actual dispatch/input receipts, packet/source digests and native context evidence for each solver.
- Plant a sibling sentinel and verify direct, indexed and inherited inputs; inspect synthesis/acceptance/implementation identity and stopping.
